name: read_file
description: Read the contents of a text file from the workspace. Use when you need to see what is actually in a file before answering about it or editing it.

path.description: Path to the file to read, relative to the workspace root (e.g. "src/app.py"). Absolute paths are accepted but must still resolve inside the workspace root.

max_lines.description: Maximum number of lines to return. Output is truncated at this many lines and a truncation notice is appended. Raise it only when the first read was cut off and the rest is actually needed.

output_schema.description: The file's contents verbatim. If the file was longer than max_lines, a final line of the form "[read_file] output truncated: showing N of M lines..." is appended after the content.

exit_codes.2: invalid input (stdin was not a JSON object, or a parameter is missing or the wrong type)
exit_codes.3: not found (the path does not exist)
exit_codes.4: not permitted (the path resolves outside the workspace root, is not a regular file, or is not readable)
